description: Port of grammars-v4 Clojure: SYMBOL's negative lookahead reproduces ANTLR's declaration-order priority of LONG, NIL and CHAR_ANY on equal-length matches, a ';' run that is a whole symbol up to end of line is a SYMBOL while a longer ';' line is a skipped comment, map entries, keywords, syntax quote with a gensym and unquote-splicing, an unclosed list, and ':nil' rejected as in ANTLR (NIL is not a symbol).
